internal_mark.requirement: Preserve this local source ink contour and its opening/unevenness; do not replace uncertainty with a guessed glyph.

ray_bundle.requirement: Retain nine individual diverging rays with nine down-left arrowheads, and keep the incident horizontal arrows distinct.
